title: 한눈에 ⑨: 커피나 차? 싸고 맛있고! 선택·나열 표현
objective: By the end, you can pick the right form for "or", "any/either" and "and" (noun or verb, speech or writing) and attach it correctly after a vowel or a consonant.
summary: A one-page overview of seven Korean endings and particles for giving choices (or) and listing things (and), with the mistakes learners make most often.

task.title: Choose, fill in, and fix
task.line: Look at the table on page 1, then check whether each word is a noun or a verb and whether the sentence is speech or formal writing before you answer.

forms.when: Between two nouns. After a consonant use 이나, after a vowel use 나.
forms.exampleMeaning: Let's meet tomorrow or the day after.

forms.when: After a verb or adjective stem, whether it ends in a vowel or a consonant.
forms.means: or (choose one of the actions or states)
forms.exampleMeaning: On weekends I clean or do the laundry.

forms.when: After a verb or adjective stem, often used twice.
forms.means: either … or; it doesn't matter which one
forms.example: 버스를 타든지 지하철을 타든지 빨리 오세요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Take the bus or the subway, it doesn't matter which, but come quickly.

forms.when: After a noun or a question word (뭐든, 언제든). After a consonant use 이든, after a vowel use 든.
forms.means: any; whatever; it doesn't matter which
forms.example: 라면이든 김밥이든 빨리 먹을 수 있는 걸로 시켜요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Ramen, gimbap, whatever. Let's order something we can eat quickly.

forms.when: Between nouns, usually repeated. After a consonant use 이며, after a vowel use 며.
forms.means: and; X and Y and so on (lots of things)
forms.example: 냉장고에 과일이며 채소며 가득 들어 있어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: The fridge is packed with fruit, vegetables and more.

forms.when: After a verb or adjective stem. Used in both speech and writing.
forms.exampleMeaning: This café is quiet, and the coffee is good too.

forms.when: After a verb or adjective stem in formal writing, news or announcements. After a consonant use -으며, after a vowel or ㄹ use -며.
forms.means: and (same as -고, but formal and written)
forms.example: 이 방은 넓으며 햇빛이 잘 듭니다.
forms.exampleMeaning: This room is spacious and gets a lot of sunlight.

watchOut: 커피거나 차 (X) → 커피나 차 (O): Use -거나 after verbs and adjectives. For nouns, use (이)나.
책나 공책 (X) → 책이나 공책 (O): If the noun ends in a consonant, add 이: 이나, 이든, 이며.
먹며 (X) → 먹으며 (O): If the stem ends in a consonant, add 으 before -며.
가던지 (X) → 가든지 (O): -던지 is used for past memories. For 'either/whichever', use -든지.
exercises: Choose the correct form: ① 점심에 (비빔밥이나 / 비빔밥거나) 냉면을 먹을까요? ② 피곤하면 좀 (자나 / 자거나) 쉬세요.
Change the word in brackets using -(으)며 (formal writing): ① 이 노트북은 (작다) ____ 가볍습니다. ② 우리 학교 도서관은 (크다) ____ 깨끗합니다.
Fill in the blank with -든지, using the verb in brackets: 전화를 ____ 문자를 보내든지 꼭 연락 주세요. (하다)
Fill in the blanks with (이)든 or (이)며: ① 영화____ 드라마____ 재미있는 거 아무거나 보자. ② 생일에 케이크____ 꽃____ 선물을 많이 받았어요.
You are texting a friend. Choose the more natural form: 우리 동네 시장은 (싸며 / 싸고) 사람들도 친절해.
Find and fix the mistake in each sentence: ① 주말에는 등산하나 낚시를 해요. ② 숙제를 하던지 게임을 하던지 마음대로 해.
answers: ① 영화든, 드라마든 ② 케이크며, 꽃이며
① 등산하나 → 등산하거나 (or: 등산이나 낚시를 해요) ② 하던지 → 하든지 (both times: 하든지 … 하든지)
